The [[Dradan/Legends|Dradan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] hailed from a '''planet'''<ref name="CAV2">{{WEGCite|story=Domain of Evil|book=Classic Adventures: Volume Two}}</ref> in the [[Drada system/Legends|Drada system]].<ref name="EAOC" /><ref name="Planetnamia">{{JCFCite|url=posts/27848315|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2007-12-11|time=7:59 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170916153037/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-43|quote=I wouldn't get your hopes up re alien homeworlds, beyond simple stuff like the Planetnamian species getting a Planetnamia on the map or things Dan and I can account for with a relatively quick reference.|archivefile=File:JasonFry-JCFAtlasHomeworlds.png}} [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', stated his intention to create homeworlds for numerous species based on context implied from their names. The Drada system appears to be the location of one such world.</ref> The [[Planet/Legends|world]] became integrated into the [[The galaxy/Legends|greater galaxy]] at some point between [[3000 BBY|3000]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> It eventually fell within the bounds of the [[Halthor sector/Legends|Halthor sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. From [[1004 BBY|1004]] to [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], as the [[New Sith Wars]] raged, the planet and system fell within unaligned or contested [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they were within space allied to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="EA" />

As the Galactic Republic gave way to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with the declaration of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]&mdash;a command that resulted in the systematic [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and led to a [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] whereby all remaining Jedi were hunted down and killed&mdash;the Dradan gave safe haven on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to Jedi fleeing government predation. However, when the Empire discovered the Dradan's pro-Jedi policy, they retaliated by exterminating the entire species and scorching their planet. Nothing remained<ref name="CAV2" /> by [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="date">Based on the appearance of Rebel Alliance agents in ''Domain of Evil'', the adventure must occur after the formation of the Alliance, which happened in 2 BBY, as established in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''. In ''The Dark Forces Saga, Part 2'', it is mentioned that [[Qu Rahn/Legends|Qu Rahn]] heard a report of the death of [[Halagad Ventor]]&mdash;who dies during the events of ''Domain of Evil''&mdash;before he contacted [[Morgan Katarn]]. This implies that Ventor died before Morgan Katarn, whose own death occurred in 1 BBY, per ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''.</ref>
